faq.q: How is a titanium hydrogen storage valve stem manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium hydrogen storage valve stem is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion; CNC machining; TIG welding (ERTi-2 filler). BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 2 CP-Ti for titanium hydrogen storage valve stem?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Laser welding (higher capital cost, limited wall thickness capability).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium hydrogen storage valve stem?
faq.a: Titanium Hydrogen Storage Valve Stem components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.
